_readme: This is the SINGLE SHARED dataset for all 4 NIRVAHA portals (Citizen, University, Industry, Government). Every portal reads/writes against these same entities via a common backend, so whichever team member builds which portal, they should seed and query against this file (or the DB tables it maps to) rather than inventing separate local data. University labsInfrastructure and incubationFacility fields are left as null/placeholder where real data was not confirmed — these should be completed by each university during onboarding (University Portal Page 1: Institution Profile), not fabricated. Two additional sections were appended: 'jharkhandIndustriesAndStartups' (67 real industries/startups/clusters from the uploaded Jharkhand dataset — raw reference data, not yet mapped to platform funding-capacity fields) and 'jharkhandNgoFunders' (9 real Jharkhand-active NGOs/foundations known to provide grants or CSR-linked funding — focus areas and funding type given, fundingCapacityBand left unset since real committed amounts vary per programme and should not be guessed).

problems.description: Hand pump near the primary school has been dry for 3 months, women and children walking 2km daily for water.
Government middle school has no functional science lab; students cannot do practicals for board prep.
Paddy crops damaged repeatedly by wild elephant herds crossing from the forest, no early warning system exists.
Untreated dyeing-unit wastewater is being released into the local stream, contaminating irrigation water downstream.
Waterlogging on Station Road every monsoon due to blocked and undersized stormwater drains.
